verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs list LLM-as-judge as a first-class evaluator type for scoring performance on dataset experiments. They also support reference-free LLM-as-judge evaluators that run automatically on production traces, configurable with filters and sampling rates. missing for 10: documented configuration of the judge itself (custom prompts/rubrics, judge model selection, score types), independent or hands-on corroboration of LLM-as-judge quality.
